title: Re-created code for: Nuclei segmentation and classification from histopathology images using federated learning for end-edge platform
description: Re-created code for the PLoS One article e0322749 (2025): nuclei segmentation (SegNet) and classification (DenseNet121) on PanNuke with Hyperband tuning, TensorFlow Lite quantization and federated learning. Includes the result tables underlying the reproduced results.
